description: This file defines the enum ImportFormatType which specifies different import file formats (XLSX, XLS, ODS) along with their MIME types. It provides a method to retrieve the format based on a string input, throwing an exception if the input is invalid.

classes.name: ImportFormatType
classes.description: An enumeration of supported import file formats with associated MIME types, providing utility methods for format lookup.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Returns the MIME type string associated with the import format.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static method to obtain the ImportFormatType enum based on a string input, case-insensitive; throws exception if not recognized.
